column1: # Required operational cutover gates. Status is `open` or `complete`; the third field records the missing proof or completed evidence.

column3: The CI rehearsal backs up a live-WAL disposable current-schema database with the production helper, verifies SQLite/metadata/hash immutability, forces unhealthy candidates and retained-runtime failures, and restores retained Python or Rust images. It SIGKILLs a Rust redeploy before backup-ready publication, reclaims the stale deploy lock, and proves durable pending/recovering/active transitions, exact candidate-stop-before-restore ordering, marker-collision recovery, and Python-free Rust-to-Rust rollback.

CI now proves built-image startup health, a typed loopback interaction plus committed app_kv write, stopped-state failure detection, and automatic retained-Python rollback; the sole residual is a concrete Serenity/Discord HTTP write and health proof in an isolated staging guild without Python running.

Rust-owned clean/existing SQLite initialization, migration, and admission are implemented by cama-db::schema_manager and cama-runtime::gateway::SqliteDatabaseAdmission. The Rust-only copied production snapshot migrated 203 rows to 231/229 with 28 newly applied migrations, quick_check=ok, and a compatible final db-check without Python readback. The remaining gate is complete old/current-schema and production repository-family coverage; Python-after-Rust readback is not required.
Make cama-rust serve the live gateway as sole runtime and prove command schemas, interaction timing, visibility, mentions, components, attachments, and errors with Python stopped.
Replay recorded OpenDota, Dotabase, Steam asset, and LLM provider success/failure/fallback contracts without live CI network.

Prove in isolated staging against real Discord the functional media contract: correct asset selection, filename/type/dimensions, behavior-relevant animation timing, and attachment replace/preserve/clear/retry; pixel/perceptual matching is not required.
Provide health metrics, structured logs, deploy metadata, alerting, and a post-deploy verification checklist.
Register persistent views and prove buttons, modals, pagination, restart recovery, stale callbacks, and reconnect behavior.

The Rust-only one-way rehearsal passed against a copied production snapshot: production cama-rust db-admit applied 28 migrations (203 to 231/229), repository, Dig/Pet, Profile/Info, referral, and Survey smokes passed, final cama-rust db-check was compatible with quick_check=ok, the source remained byte-identical, and python_post_rust_readback=false. The older A/B runner remains optional development evidence, not a cutover round-trip requirement.

One fail-closed BOT_RUNTIME selector swaps only the existing bot implementation; CI and offline deploy rehearsals prove identical UID/volume/environment/GIT_SHA/SSH handoff, Rust-only redeploy without Python, and retained-image Python restoration.

All ten production background tasks are composed behind READY under the shared WorkerSpec supervisor; 79 worker tests plus runtime_lifecycle prove startup catch-up, bounded retry/restart, durable idempotent recovery, cancellation, reconnect, and graceful joined shutdown, including persisted Dig-weather broadcast recovery.
Both images acquire /app/data/.cama-runtime.lock before DB or gateway startup; bidirectional fs2/flock tests and CI/local container overlap smoke reject the second runtime and prove no DB is created.

Current production wiring uses concrete existing-schema SQLite adapters for the durable repositories audited so far. The Rust-only copied-snapshot rehearsal covers fourteen shared repository families plus Dig/Pet, Profile/Info, referrals, and Survey. The remaining gate is a complete production-callsite inventory, replacement of any unintended durable in-memory store, and transactional Rust coverage for every persistent family; Python-after-Rust interoperability is not required.
